t: An open hardware ESP32-S2 board for learning electronics and programming.
steps: Find the Franzininho WiFi project page and repository.
Obtain a board and a micro USB cable.
Choose Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, MicroPython, or CircuitPython.
Install the tooling on one computer.
Upload a blink program over USB.
Check the Wi-Fi settings before connecting the board to school networks.
